title: 3rd Point: The Necessity of Prophethood from Beauty and Art in the Universe

questions.question: What main claim is made at the beginning of this passage about beauty in the universe and the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: The passage says that the beauty seen in creation proves the need for the messengership of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: What does the beauty and careful design in created things show about their Creator?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator wills beauty and loves to make things in a beautiful and adorned way.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Creator’s love for beautiful art point to beyond the created objects themselves?
questions.answer: It points to a special love for the highest perfections shown in creation.

questions.question: Why does the passage give a special place to human beings among created things?
questions.answer: Because human beings are presented as the most aware, most complete, and most conscious result of creation.

questions.question: How are human beings compared to a tree in the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings are compared to the fruit of the tree of creation.

questions.question: Why is the fruit used as an important image in the argument?
questions.answer: Because the fruit is described as the most complete part, with the broadest awareness and the widest view.

questions.question: Among all people, what kind of person is described as the highest and brightest?
questions.answer: It is the person with the widest understanding and the most universal awareness.

questions.question: What does this highest human being do with his awareness and understanding?
questions.answer: He uses them fully for worship, noticing Allah’s art, and thanking Him for His blessings.

questions.question: What are the two “spheres” mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: One is the sphere of Allah’s rule and artistic creation, and the other is the sphere of worship, reflection, admiration, gratitude, and faith.

questions.question: How is the first sphere described?
questions.answer: It is described as splendid, orderly, and full of beautiful art.

questions.question: How is the second sphere described?
questions.answer: It is described as bright, wide, and centered on worship, thought, thankfulness, and belief.

questions.question: What is the relationship between the second sphere and the first sphere?
questions.answer: The second sphere serves the first with all its strength and acts in its name.

questions.question: What does this relationship help us understand about the leader of the second sphere?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that he is very closely connected to the Creator and is beloved and accepted by Him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Prophet’s worship and praise?
questions.answer: It describes his worship and praise as so great and sincere that they echo through all creation.

questions.question: What question does the passage ask about whether the Creator would ignore such a servant?
questions.answer: It asks whether it could make sense for the Creator to stay indifferent to such a beautiful and devoted servant.

questions.question: What answer does the passage give to that question?
questions.answer: It says that this is impossible; the Creator would certainly speak to him and appoint him as a Messenger.

questions.question: What final conclusion is stated at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The conclusion is that the true religion with Allah is Islam and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

questions.question: Which sign in the universe is used as evidence at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The sign used is the beauty and artistry seen throughout creation.

questions.question: What does this beauty make necessary, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It makes the messengership of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, necessary.

questions.question: Why does beautiful design in creation show more than just power?
questions.answer: Because it also shows a deliberate choice to make things lovely and decorated.

questions.question: What inner quality of the Maker is linked to this choice for beauty?
questions.answer: The passage links it to a holy love and deep inclination toward perfection.

questions.question: Toward which created being should this love be directed most strongly, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It should be directed most strongly toward human beings.

questions.question: Why are human beings given this high rank in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they are described as the most enlightened and most complete among creation.

questions.question: What does it mean that the human being is the “fruit” of creation in this passage?
questions.answer: It means the human being is the most meaningful and comprehensive outcome of creation.

questions.question: What special qualities belong to the best among human beings?
questions.answer: He has the widest understanding, the broadest awareness, and the highest spiritual rank.

questions.question: What kind of meeting is described between this person and the Creator?
questions.answer: He is described as one who meets his Creator and receives His address.

questions.question: Name three things this chosen person does with his God-given awareness.
questions.answer: He worships Allah, appreciates His art, and thanks Him for His blessings.

questions.question: What does the first “signboard” or sphere represent?
questions.answer: It represents Allah’s lordship and the beautiful artistry shown in creation.

questions.question: What does the second “signboard” or sphere represent?
questions.answer: It represents worship, reflection, admiration, gratitude, and faith.

questions.question: How does the second sphere behave toward the first sphere?
questions.answer: It works fully in service to the first sphere.

questions.question: What can be understood from the close link between these two spheres?
questions.answer: The one leading the second sphere must have a very close relationship with the Creator.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the Creator in the argument near the end?
questions.answer: It describes Him as generous and as One who loves the beauty in what He creates.

questions.question: What example is given to show how carefully the Creator provides for His creatures?
questions.answer: The passage says He even considers the tastes of the mouth.

questions.question: Based on the passage, why would it be unreasonable to think the Creator would not appoint such a servant as Messenger?
questions.answer: Because a Creator who cares so greatly for beauty and responds to such devoted praise would not leave His finest servant without speaking to him and sending him as Messenger.

questions.question: What verse idea opens this part of the passage?
questions.answer: It opens with the idea that loving Allah requires following the Messenger.

questions.question: How does the passage connect love of Allah with the Prophet’s role?
questions.answer: It shows that the Prophet is the one to be followed if a person truly loves Allah.

questions.question: What visible reality in the universe is treated as certain proof?
questions.answer: The visible reality is the beauty and artistry found in creation.

questions.question: What does this visible beauty reveal about the Maker’s will?
questions.answer: It reveals that the Maker intentionally wants beauty to appear.

questions.question: Besides will, what other quality of the Maker is shown by adorned creation?
questions.answer: It shows a strong desire to beautify and decorate creation.

questions.question: What do this will and desire together suggest about the Creator’s relation to perfection?
questions.answer: They suggest that the Creator loves the perfect art He displays.

questions.question: Why is man described as the most fitting place for this love to be focused?
questions.answer: Because man is presented as the most conscious and most complete creature.

questions.question: What two qualities of the “fruit” are emphasized in the passage?
questions.answer: Its broad understanding and its universal awareness are emphasized.

questions.question: Which person among humanity is singled out in this argument?
questions.answer: The one with the widest awareness and greatest understanding is singled out.

questions.question: What makes this person spiritually outstanding according to the passage?
questions.answer: He turns all his abilities toward worship, reflection on Allah’s art, and gratitude for blessings.

questions.question: What does the first sphere show?
questions.answer: It shows divine rule and beautiful craftsmanship in creation.

questions.question: What does the second sphere show?
questions.answer: It shows the human response of worship, belief, thankfulness, and thoughtful reflection.

questions.question: Why is the second sphere important in the argument for messengership?
questions.answer: Because it responds to the first sphere completely and points to a leader who represents that response perfectly.

questions.question: Who is the leader of the second sphere implied to be?
questions.answer: It points to Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the effect of his praise and gratitude?
questions.answer: It describes them as so powerful that all realms of creation seem to echo with them.

questions.question: What conclusion is drawn from the idea that the Creator is not indifferent?
questions.answer: The conclusion is that the Creator speaks to this servant and appoints him as His Messenger.

questions.question: How do the closing lines summarize the message of the passage?
questions.answer: They affirm that Islam is the true religion before Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger.

questions.question: What is the argument structure of this passage in simple terms?
questions.answer: It moves from the beauty of creation to the qualities of the Creator, then to the need for a greatest human responder, and finally to the Prophet’s messengership.

questions.question: What observation about the universe starts this chain of reasoning?
questions.answer: The starting observation is that the universe contains beautiful and skillful art.

questions.question: What does beautiful art in creation tell us about the One who made it?
questions.answer: It tells us that He chooses beauty and loves perfection in what He creates.

questions.question: Why does the passage move from beauty in creation to human beings?
questions.answer: Because human beings are described as the most aware and complete part of creation.

questions.question: In what way is man said to be like the fruit of a tree?
questions.answer: Man is said to be the final and most comprehensive result of creation.

questions.question: What type of person among all humans would best match the purpose of creation in this passage?
questions.answer: The person with the broadest understanding and deepest awareness of Allah would best match it.

questions.question: What acts show that this person fulfills that purpose?
questions.answer: Worship, appreciating divine artistry, and thanking Allah show it.

questions.question: What is the first sphere mainly about?
questions.answer: It is mainly about Allah’s lordship and the beauty of His creative work.

questions.question: What is the second sphere mainly about?
questions.answer: It is mainly about faith-filled response through worship, reflection, admiration, and gratitude.

questions.question: Why does the passage say the second sphere acts in the name of the first?
questions.answer: Because it answers and serves the meanings shown in the first sphere.

questions.question: What does this service say about the one who leads the second sphere?
questions.answer: It says that he has a very near and honored relationship with the Creator.

questions.question: How does the passage appeal to reason near the end?
questions.answer: It asks whether it makes sense that a Creator so attentive and generous would ignore His best worshipping servant.

questions.question: What answer does the passage expect from the reader to that question?
questions.answer: It expects the reader to say that such neglect would make no sense.

questions.question: What two actions of Allah toward this servant are presented as certain?
questions.answer: Speaking to him and appointing him as Messenger are presented as certain.

questions.question: Why is the Prophet’s example important for other people according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because the Creator would want his praiseworthy way to spread to others.

questions.question: What belief statements close the passage?
questions.answer: They state that Islam is the religion accepted by Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say is clearly seen in the universe?
questions.answer: It says that beauty in artistic creation is clearly seen in the universe.

questions.question: What religious truth does the passage say follows from that beauty?
questions.answer: It says that this leads to the truth of Prophet Muhammad’s messengership.

questions.question: What do the fine forms of creatures show about their Maker’s intention?
questions.answer: They show that the Maker intends beauty and adornment.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does a love of beautiful art in creation show about the Creator?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator has a sacred love for perfection.

questions.question: Why is humanity the main focus after that?
questions.answer: Because humanity is described as the most conscious and enlightened part of creation.

questions.question: What image helps explain humanity’s place in creation?
questions.answer: The image of fruit on a tree helps explain it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the best individual among human beings?
questions.answer: It says that this person has the widest vision and the most universal consciousness.

questions.question: What relationship does this person have with the Creator?
questions.answer: He is described as one who meets the Creator and receives His address.

questions.question: What are some of the ways this person responds to Allah?
questions.answer: He worships Allah, reflects on His art, admires it, and gives thanks.

questions.question: What two large realities are set side by side in the passage?
questions.answer: Divine rule shown in creation and human worship shown in faith are set side by side.

questions.question: How is the first reality pictured?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a grand and beautifully arranged display of dominion and art.

questions.question: How is the second reality pictured?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a bright and wide field of worship, thought, gratitude, and belief.

questions.question: What does it mean that the second works in the name of the first?
questions.answer: It means that worship and faith answer the signs found in creation and represent them properly.

questions.question: What does this suggest about the rank of the one who leads that worship?
questions.answer: It suggests that he is especially near to Allah and deeply loved by Him.

questions.question: Which detail is used to show the Creator’s generosity and care in a small but meaningful way?
questions.answer: The passage mentions that He even provides for the tastes people experience in eating.

questions.question: Why would such a Creator not leave the greatest worshipper without revelation?
questions.answer: Because it would not fit His wisdom, generosity, and care to ignore the servant who praises Him most fully.

questions.question: What final message should a student take from the ending of this passage?
questions.answer: A student should understand that the passage ends by affirming Islam and the messengership of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: According to this passage, what feature of the universe supports belief in the Prophet’s messengership?
questions.answer: The feature is the beauty and artistic excellence found throughout creation.

questions.question: How certain does the passage say this proof is?
questions.answer: It says the proof is as certain as something directly witnessed.

questions.question: What does beautiful creation show about the Creator’s character and action?
questions.answer: It shows that He acts with purpose, choosing beauty and decoration in what He makes.

questions.question: What deeper meaning is drawn from this choice for beauty?
questions.answer: The deeper meaning is that the Creator loves the perfections displayed in His art.

questions.question: Why is the human being central in this argument?
questions.answer: Because the human being is described as the most aware and complete creature.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by calling man the fruit of creation?
questions.answer: It means man is the most developed and meaningful result of creation.

questions.question: What qualities make one human being the greatest among people in this passage?
questions.answer: His broad vision, universal awareness, and complete turning to Allah make him the greatest.

questions.question: For what purposes does this great person use his abilities?
questions.answer: He uses them for worship, reflection on divine artistry, and gratitude for blessings.

questions.question: What is the first of the two spheres?
questions.answer: It is the sphere of divine lordship and the display of crafted beauty in the world.

questions.question: What is the second of the two spheres?
questions.answer: It is the sphere of worship, faith, thought, admiration, and thankfulness.

questions.question: In what way does the second sphere relate to the first?
questions.answer: It supports and serves the first completely.

questions.question: What does that service reveal about the leader of the second sphere?
questions.answer: It reveals that he is closely connected to Allah and honored by Him.

questions.question: How is the Prophet’s praise described in terms of its effect on creation?
questions.answer: It is described as so strong and heartfelt that all parts of creation seem to resound with it.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Creator would naturally want for such a servant’s good example?
questions.answer: It says He would want that noble example to spread to other people.

questions.question: What two things does the passage say the Creator would definitely do for such a servant?
questions.answer: He would speak to him and appoint him as a Messenger.

questions.question: What strong phrase does the passage use in meaning to reject the opposite idea?
questions.answer: It strongly rejects it by saying that the opposite could never be accepted.

questions.question: How do the last two statements complete the whole argument?
questions.answer: They complete it by declaring Islam as the true religion before Allah and Muhammad as Allah’s Messenger.
